original archives and prior worker outputs are read-only and unmodified
architectural definition, captured value, semantic interpretation kept separate

header_source_applicability: tu102 Turing headers are the definition source used for TU10x/TU106 matching; other families are not used as TU106 definitions; local evidence does not exclude stepping-specific silicon differences

definitions.MMIO_BAR0: register/address within 16 MiB BAR0 window with MMIO access
definitions.MMIO_BAR0_BASE: MMIO BAR0 base address with null access (FBIF_BASE/GSP_BASE)
definitions.CONTROL_SPACE: NV_CTRL control-interface addresses, not MMIO BAR0 registers
definitions.CONSTANT: enum/constant value misused as a register address

namespace.preserved: 42 registers, 3 bases, 3 constants, 3 control-space, 1 PCI config preserved; no evidence changes any distinction
notes: 3 misaligned addresses are exactly the 3 constants (0xffff, 0xface, 0x10de); constants are values, not addresses

control-space registers (0x00b6687c/80/84) lie numerically inside the BAR0 window but are architecturally NV_CTRL control-space; control-space classification alone does not prove a location is physically outside BAR0
misalignment flag applies only to constants mislabeled as addresses; no MMIO_BAR0 register is misaligned
